method: Deterministic six-group k-means over eight standardized geometric descriptors, computed on 500 m analysis windows. Exploratory, not validated urban-tissue classification. No trained vision/AI model or historical attribution.
limitations: No image-based completeness detection: review flags are low mapping beside roads and mapped neighbours.
Analysis cells are not tissue boundaries.
Low mapping does not prove vacant ground.
Road bearing distributions do not prove grid, fishbone, radial or honeycomb topology.
Class count, resolution and source completeness influence results.
Same-family cells need not share a historical origin.
